text:
Maya: Quick sync — Zephyr pilot ask landed from Sales: per-tenant encryption (customer-managed KMS), dedicated capacity, and firm launch acceptance criteria. Need cross-team alignment on scope, timeline, and measurable launch gates.
Priya: Do they require HSM day-one or is KMS okay for pilot? Any committed dates?
Maya: Sales says pilot in ~7 weeks and HSM is a later milestone. Pilot must include audit logs and a migration plan to HSM.
Alex: Infra view: dedicated GPU pool + VPC peering + KMS connector doable in ~8-10 business days if we prioritize. HSM vendor integration (attestation, cert rotation) is a separate 3-4 week project. IAM scoping and audit-log routing are blockers.
Jordan: Security: pilot with customer-managed KMS is acceptable if we clearly call out what we can and cannot claim. We'll need an evidence bundle (audit exports, key-access matrix) — estimate 1 sprint to prepare and review with Legal. HSM attestation must remain off the pilot claim.
Sam: Runtime: p95 targets at 2k tokens are achievable with tuned model variant + quantization + warmed KV cache. p99 150ms is not achievable with current model families. We'll need experiments to quantify quality delta under quant. I estimate initial perf matrix in 7-10 business days.
Lee: Product: propose acceptance gates for pilot:
- measurable perf: p95 <= 200ms on pilot-shaped traffic
- quality delta <= 2% on prioritized eval set
- audit logs accessible for last 30 days
- infra runbook + SLO rollback plan green
These are "soft" gates for pilot sign-off; HSM + tighter p99 SLA after pilot.
Priya: I'll negotiate SOW: ask for a small committed capacity deposit and agreement to use customer KMS for pilot. Will surface HSM as a roadmap commitment.
Maya: Risks called out: 1) quantization harms quality; 2) HSM delays elongate full contract; 3) tail latency under concurrency. Mitigations: eval harness, model fallback, clear customer comms.
Sam: Runtime action items I can own: run latency matrix and quant A/B (512/1024/2048), KV cache warmup tests, and p95/p99 under pilot QPS. Deliver initial report in 10 business days.
Alex: Infra actions: I'll draft the infra runbook (VPC peering, dedicated pool provisioning steps, KMS connector spec, audit-log export path, IAM scoping). I'll open the infra tickets and assign owners. ETA: 8 business days to first draft.
Jordan: Security actions: I'll produce a compliance-gap doc mapping pilot deliverables to SOC2 controls and the legal wording we must use about key custody. ETA: end of next week.
Lee: I'll prepare the eval suite for Zephyr focusing on hallucination, latency-sensitive prompts, and regression thresholds. Link to eval template will be posted in #eng-evals.
Priya: I'll draft the customer-facing pilot scope and acceptance criteria and route to Sales + Legal for sign-off. ETA: 3 days.
Maya: deploy-bot please create a preflight ticket we can track. @Alex @Sam @Jordan please add owner tags to tasks.
deploy-bot: New ticket created: PROD-9998 "Zephyr pilot preflight" assigned to Alex.
Alex: putting ticket links and runbook in this thread once created.
Sam: one technical note — if quantization causes >2% quality regression we should be ready to propose a slightly smaller model for pilot with documented uplift plan to the full model later. I've seen that work better with customers.
Jordan: Agree. Also need to define the exact wording for "soft SLA" — Legal wants precise phrasing (targets vs guarantees). Maya, can you coordinate?
Maya: Yep, I'll coordinate with Legal and update the acceptance doc. Action recap: Maya -> Legal wording & initiative doc; Priya -> customer SOW; Alex -> infra runbook & tickets; Sam -> runtime perf experiments; Jordan -> compliance gap + legal phrasing; Lee -> eval suite. Checkpoint: same time next Tuesday.
Priya: I'll push Sales to accept the pilot constraints and circulate the SOW draft today.
Lee: I'll queue the evals once Sam posts configs.
Maya: Thanks team. If any owner slips, flag in #product-urgent so we can reallocate.
